MMS Protocol 2000 - Topical

Protocol mms miracle-mineral-solution topical skin external

Evidence: Grade C (traditional_use)

Summary

MMS topical protocol applied directly to skin for localized support. Diluted activated solution applied to affected areas (MMS-2000).

Indications

  • skin-conditions
  • wound-care
  • localized-infection

Contraindications

  • severe-skin-sensitivity
  • open-wounds
  • broken-skin

Dosage

Diluted activated MMS solution applied topically as needed (MMS-2000)

Frequency: 1-3 times daily on affected area
